The ego lane is heavily marked with black tar-sealant snakes and dark skid marks that wander erratically, while crisp white lane lines edge both sides of the lane. A grooved rumble strip runs along the right shoulder. The oncoming lane is separated to the left, and the road ahead is clear of traffic. Bright sky with high visibility completes the scene.
